official_site_checks: Official public series pages expose Associated Name(s) and Related Series(s), which are retained in the Aidoku details description with relationship labels when present. Live /hot-updates cards expose chapter links and cover-host series ULIDs; /series/<ULID> resolves without a slug. Official public /search HTML exposes tri-state Official Translation, Anime Adaptation, and Adult Content controls. Regression tests verify each filter routes its Any/True/False state to the matching form field; Cloudflare challenge pages are rejected across search, details, chapter-list, reader and Home requests rather than accepted as empty results. Live official /search UI exposes all six sort modes, author text search, trivalent official/anime/adult filters, and 38 include/exclude tags; Aidoku DynamicFilters now exposes the supported UI and routes those values through the already-tested advanced-search fields. The visible Series Status and Series Type groups expose Ongoing/Complete/Hiatus/Canceled and Manga/Manhwa/Manhua/OEL. Selecting Complete and Manga in the live page produced included_status=Complete and included_type=Manga; the provider and request builder now expose these options.
package_hash_scope: Exact SHA-256 of the package served by the live PanelNest catalog.
